reason: Reproduced end to end in a woven build with the real tracer and WithSpanPool(true). The weak.Pointer key identifies the span object, so a stale entry left on a finished root (re-created by the woven BindStartSpan after Finished) is inherited by the next request that reuses the object. Result: the agent received request B's span carrying request A's SQLi (bleed), or request B's own SQLi was dropped (false negative, no orphan fallback). Requires the opt-in experimental span pool. The finder's AnnotationFor/Report(ctx) trigger is unreachable from woven sinks at HEAD (Report callers pass nil ctx), but BindStartSpan is a reachable trigger.
